billing.storage_line: Extra storage, {month}: {blocks, plural, one {# block} other {# blocks}} of {gb} GB
email.account_deletion.body:
Hello,

You asked us to delete your Household account. It is switched off now: nobody can sign in to it, and every browser and device has been signed out. In {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} it will be deleted for good, together with what you kept privately. What you added to a household you share stays with that household, without your name on it.

If you change your mind, open the link below before then. It cancels the deletion, and you can sign in again as before.

{link}

If you didn’t ask for this, open the link now, then sign in and change your password.
email.account_deletion.subject: Your Household account will be deleted in {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}
email.billing_moved.body:
Hello,

{member} took over billing for {household} on Household, as you offered. From now on the subscription is charged to them, not to you. What you have already paid for runs to the end of its period, and nothing was charged twice.

You are still an owner of {household}, and can see its billing here:

{link}
email.billing_moved.subject: {member} now pays for {household} on Household
email.billing_offer.body:
Hello,

{member} pays for {household} on Household and has offered to hand billing to you. Nothing changes unless you accept: until then {member} keeps paying, and the subscription carries on exactly as it is.

To accept and add your card, or to decline, open:

{link}

The offer lapses in 14 days.
email.billing_offer.subject: {member} offered you billing for {household} on Household
email.export_ready.body:
Hello,

The export you asked for{kind, select, household { of {household}} other {}} is ready. You can download it from Household for the next {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}:

{link}

After that it is removed, and you can ask for a new one at any time.
email.export_ready.subject: Your Household export is ready
email.graduate.body:
Hello,

{owner} is turning your child profile in {household}, {member}, into an account of your own with this email address. Everything you made stays with you.

To finish, open the link below and choose a password. It works for 14 days.

{link}

Until then, you sign in with your PIN as before. If you weren’t expecting this, you can ignore this email: nothing changes unless you choose a password.
email.graduate.subject: {owner} is setting up an account of your own on Household
email.household_deletion.body:
Hello,

An owner of {household} has scheduled the household for deletion on Household. In {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} everything in it will be deleted for good, for every member. Until then it works as it did, and any owner can cancel the deletion in the household’s settings.

If there is anything in it you want to keep, take a copy before then.
email.household_deletion.subject: {household} will be deleted in {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}
email.household_deletion_cancelled.body:
Hello,

The deletion of {household} on Household was cancelled. Nothing in it was removed, and it goes on as before.
email.household_suspended.body:
Hello,

{household} has been suspended on Household, and nobody can open it until the suspension is lifted. This is what we can tell you about why:

{notice}

If you think this is a mistake, contact Household support.
email.household_suspended.subject: {household} has been suspended
email.household_unsuspended.body:
Hello,

The suspension of {household} on Household has been lifted. Everything in it is as it was, and each device loads it again the next time it syncs.
email.household_unsuspended.subject: {household} is no longer suspended
email.identity_linked.body:
Hello,

{provider} was just linked to your Household account, and can now sign you in to it.

If you did this, there’s nothing more to do. If you didn’t, reset your password now, then unlink {provider} in your account:

{link}
email.identity_linked.subject: {provider} can now sign you in to Household
email.invitation.subject: {inviter} invited you to {household} on Household
email.invoice.body:
Hello,

The payment for {household} on Household went through. Invoice {number} is ready, with the subscription and any extra storage as separate lines.

You can read and download it here:

{link}

You are getting this because you pay for {household}.
email.invoice.subject: Your Household invoice for {household}
email.member_removed.body:
Hello,

An owner of {household} removed you from the household on Household. You no longer see anything in it, and the other households you belong to are as they were. What you made there stays with the household.

If you think this was a mistake, ask one of its owners to invite you again.
email.member_removed.subject: You were removed from {household} on Household
email.mfa_disabled.body:
Hello,

The second step for your Household account, the code from your authenticator app, was just turned off. Signing in now needs only your password.

If you did this, there’s nothing more to do. If you didn’t, reset your password now, then turn the second step on again:

{link}
email.mfa_disabled.subject: The second step was turned off for your Household account
email.password_changed.body:
Hello,

The password for your Household account was just changed.

If you did this, there’s nothing more to do. If you didn’t, reset your password now:

{link}
email.password_changed.subject: Your Household password was changed
email.password_reset.body:
Hello,

Someone asked to reset the password for your Household account. To choose a new one, open the link below. It works for one hour.

{link}

If you didn’t ask for this, you can ignore this email. Your password stays as it is.
email.password_reset.subject: Reset your Household password
email.payment_failed.subject: We couldn’t collect the payment for {household}
email.payment_not_collected.body:
Hello,

The bank payment that was to start the subscription for {household} on Household did not go through, so the subscription was not started and nothing was charged. {household} is as it was before.

To try again, from the same account or with another payment method, subscribe here:

{link}

You are getting this because you set up the payment for {household}.
email.payment_not_collected.subject: The payment for {household} did not go through
email.recovery_code_used.subject: A recovery code was used for your Household account
email.register_existing.body:
Hello,

Someone, perhaps you, tried to create a Household account with this email address. It already has one, so nothing was changed.

To get in, sign in. If you’ve forgotten your password, you can reset it from the same page:

{link}

If this wasn’t you, you can ignore this email.
email.register_existing.subject: You already have a Household account
email.retention_warning.body:
Hello,

{household} is {state, select, canceled {cancelled} other {read-only}} on Household, and its data will be deleted in {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}. Until then, everything in it can still be read and exported.

To keep it, an owner can resume the subscription from the household’s settings, and nothing will be deleted. To keep a copy instead, export the household from the same place.

You are getting this because you are an owner of {household}.
email.retention_warning.subject: {household}’s data will be deleted in {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}
email.token_reuse.body:
Hello,

We signed {named, select, yes {“{device}”} other {one of your devices}} out of your Household account, because its sign-in was used twice, which happens when someone has taken a copy of it.

If it’s your device, sign in on it again and there’s nothing more to do. If you don’t recognise it, reset your password now. That signs every device out, whoever holds it:

{link}
email.token_reuse.subject: We signed a device out of your Household account
email.verify_email.body:
Hello,

Please confirm that this is your email address by opening the link below. It works for 24 hours.

{link}

If you didn’t create a Household account, you can ignore this email.
email.verify_email.subject: Confirm your email address for Household

sync.inbox.empty: Everything is in sync. Nothing needs your attention.
sync.inbox.empty_offline: Nothing needs your attention. What you change offline is saved, and sent when the connection is back.
sync.inbox.error.text: This browser couldn’t open its own copy of the household, which is where changes that need you are kept. Nothing was lost. Reload the page to try again. If it keeps happening, check that the browser lets this site store data.
sync.inbox.error.title: These can’t be shown right now
sync.inbox.lead: Changes you made in this browser that weren’t saved as you made them. Each one waits here until you decide what to do with it.
sync.inbox.offline: You’re offline. You can still decide here: what you choose is kept in this browser and sent when the connection is back.
sync.inbox.overridden: Part of your change was replaced ({when})
sync.inbox.readonly.text: This household can’t be changed right now. Everything waiting here is kept in this browser, and changes held because of that are sent by themselves once it can be changed again.

sync.kept.overridden.text: This was also changed somewhere else at about the same time. For what is shown below, the other value was saved, not yours. Here is what you entered, beside what is saved now.
sync.kept.overridden.title: Part of your change was replaced
sync.kept.replaced.text: This was also changed somewhere else while your change was on its way, and yours was saved over that version. The version yours replaced wasn’t lost: it was kept.
sync.kept.replaced.title: Your change replaced a version you hadn’t seen
sync.needs_connection: This needs a connection. Nothing was changed. Try again when you’re back online.
sync.not_receiving: Not receiving changes from other members right now. What you change is still saved and sent.
sync.rejected.kept: Your change isn’t lost. It stays in this browser until you decide what to do with it.
sync.rejected.readonly: This household is read-only right now, so this can’t be sent again yet.
sync.rejected.reason.entitlement_read_on: This household is read-only right now, so this change wasn’t saved. It isn’t lost: it is kept in this browser and sent by itself once the household can be changed again.
sync.rejected.reason.entitlement_restric: An owner has restricted changes to this household, so this change wasn’t saved. It isn’t lost: it is kept in this browser and sent by itself once the restriction is lifted.
sync.rejected.reason.fair_use_ceiling: This part of the household already holds as many entries as it can, so this one wasn’t added. Remove some you no longer need, then try again.
sync.rejected.reason.forbidden: You aren’t allowed to make this change, so it wasn’t saved. If you think you should be, ask an owner of the household, then try again.
sync.rejected.reason.monotonicity_violat: This value is out of order with the entry next to it, shown below. Here a value can’t be lower than the one before it or higher than the one after it. Is one of them a typo?
sync.rejected.reason.not_found: What this change was for isn’t available any more, so it couldn’t be saved. It may have been deleted, or you may no longer have access to it.
sync.rejected.reason.other: This change wasn’t accepted, and the reason given isn’t one we can explain here. What you entered is shown below. You can try again, or discard it.
sync.rejected.reason.payload_too_large: This change is too large to send, so it wasn’t saved. What you entered is shown below: save it again in smaller parts, then discard this one.
sync.rejected.reason.validation_failed: Something in this change isn’t valid, so it wasn’t saved. What you entered is shown below.
sync.rejected.retried: Your change to {name} will be sent again.
sync.retry.nothing: Nothing was sent: this is no longer in this browser, so there was nothing to change. You can let your change go.
sync.withdrawn.access: Your access to this changed, so it was removed from this device.
sync.withdrawn.module: This module was turned off for the household. Nothing was deleted — it comes back if it is turned on again.
